description_en: Queries the URL of a webshell that is used to access a host
description_zh: 调用DescribeHostWebShell接口获取专属集群主机Webshell登录地址
kebab_example: aliyun cddc describe-host-web-shell --dedicated-host-id ch-bp10a5id3boqi0000 --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-b --region cn-hangzhou
name: DescribeHostWebShell

parameters.description_en: The host ID. You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHosts](~~200944~~) operation to query the host ID.
parameters.help_en: The host ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/200944.html operation to query the host ID
parameters.name: dedicated_host_id

parameters.description_en: The region ID of the host. You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute](~~213010~~) operation to query the region ID.
parameters.help_en: The region ID of the host. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213010.html operation to query the region ID
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.description_en: The zone ID of the host. You can call the [DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute](~~213010~~) operation to query the zone ID.
parameters.description_zh: 主机所在可用区ID。可调用[DescribeDedicatedHostAttribute](~~213010~~)获取。
parameters.help_en: The zone ID of the host. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213010.html operation to query the zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 主机所在可用区ID。可调用https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/213010.html获取
parameters.name: zone_id
